Haruka and the boys train hard to prepare for the showdown against Samezuka; after Day 1 of the tournament, Gou and Amakata-sensei treat the boys to a carb-rich feast and allow them to take a breather.

While Haruka and the boys redouble their training in the wake of prefecturals, Makoto notices Gou looking troubled and asks her what's wrong; she tells him that Coach Sasabe has been busy with his Swim Club lately.
